title: Browser Agent, Browser Protocol, or Automation Script?
summary: A simple decision guide for choosing between Webwright, Agent Browser Protocol, browser-use, and plain browser automation.
author: OpenAgent.bot Editors
seoTitle: Browser Agent vs Browser Protocol vs Automation Script
seoDescription: Choose between a browser agent framework, browser protocol, browser-use style library, or plain automation script.
body: Browser automation now has several layers. Picking the wrong layer can make a simple task too heavy or a risky task too loose.

Use [Webwright](/agents/webwright) when the browser task is long and decision-heavy. Use [Agent Browser Protocol](/plugins/agent-browser-protocol) when browser access should become a reusable agent tool. Use [browser-use](/agents/browser-use) when you want a practical browser agent library. Use a plain script when the page flow is stable and deterministic.
| Agent makes decisions across pages | Browser agent framework |
| Multiple agents need browser access | Browser protocol or MCP tool |
| Researching long tasks | Webwright-style benchmark workflow |
Start with a non-production account, record actions, block irreversible steps, and require approval before sensitive forms, payments, or account changes.
Do not start by giving a browser agent full access. Start with one workflow, one success metric, and one recovery plan.
